title: AKEF (AI Knowledge Engineering Framework)
summary: Deterministic 4-pass knowledge compiler translating Markdown specifications into multi-modal educational assets, automated lecture slides, and rich diagrams.
description: An open-source compiler architecture featuring AST parsing, lexical & semantic invariant validation, Knowledge Intermediate Representation (K-IR), and Scene IR multi-target rendering engine.

title: AWS Serverless Medallion Lakehouse
summary: High-throughput real-time lakehouse on AWS with automated Bronze-to-Gold data quality validation and Snappy Parquet partition compaction.
description: Architected petabyte-scale storage on AWS S3 with AWS Glue ETL jobs, Snappy Parquet columnar compaction, and serverless querying via AWS Athena and Amazon Redshift Spectrum.

title: Databricks Delta Lakehouse & Unity Catalog
summary: Enterprise unified data governance architecture with Delta Lake ACID transaction logs, PySpark streaming, and fine-grained RBAC.
description: Implemented zero-copy data clones, time-travel auditing, and automated vacuuming schedules with centralized row/column level security policies via Unity Catalog.

title: Stateful Multi-Agent Workflow Engine
summary: Distributed multi-agent pipeline using LangGraph, Vector DB retrieval, and SQLite state checkpointers for deterministic code synthesis.
description: Coordinates parallel research agents, architectural validation agents, and test synthesis agents with structured output enforcement and automatic retry loops.
